profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer @ Microsoft | Forward Deployed Engineer AI & Cloud | ex-Meta
profile.summary:
Senior Software Engineer with 10+ years of experience building scalable backend systems and distributed services, with a strong focus on product impact.
 
I specialize in designing reliable APIs, financial workflows, and data-driven features that directly improve user experience and business outcomes. My work often sits at the intersection of backend engineering and product, where system design decisions shape how users interact with a platform.
 
I’ve worked at Meta, BitGo, IBM, and Favor, leading initiatives across onboarding platforms, fraud detection systems, search infrastructure, and observability improvements that increased reliability and performance at scale.
 
Currently, I’m exploring AI-driven systems and agent-based solutions at Microsoft, applying my backend and product experience to a new generation of intelligent applications.
 
I’m particularly interested in solving complex problems involving distributed systems, integrations, and product platforms that operate reliably at scale.
